title: DECISION: event emission after tx.commit, not inside transaction
description: In insert_message_with_attachments (crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs), the events_tx.send call is placed after tx.commit(), not before or inside the transaction. Alternative: send the event inside the transaction before commit, or immediately after the message INSERT before committing. Rejected because a listener receiving the state-change event will immediately call Message/changes or Message/get; if the event fires before the commit the DB query returns no row (the write is not yet visible), causing a spurious empty result that the client must handle as a transient error. Post-commit emission guarantees that by the time any listener queries, the data is durable and visible. The send() uses a fire-and-forget pattern (result discarded with let _ =) because a full event channel is a backpressure condition, not a delivery error — the periodic poll path catches up any missed events. Location: crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs insert_message_with_attachments.
